h:
✨ 告别将视频分割成姿势图像的繁琐琐事！ LTX 2.5 运动同步正式发布，这是对 LTX 2.3 的大规模升级。这种先进的工作流程可以毫不费力地传输精确、逼真的运动任何在一个流畅的过程中将视频直接发送到您选择的角色上！ 🔄

⚠️ 创作者们请注意：此设置可以像梦一样处理逼真的 3D 风格，但它可能会难以处理平面的 2D 动漫图像。

🛠️ 变更日志和错误修复

FlyV2.0中已修复：更好的保真度和运动依从性。添加了一个 VideoStitch 节点，用于在输出和原始输入中进行比较。还添加了一个元数据跟踪器节点，供那些想要在 CivitAI 上分享其创作的人使用。

🎨 为什么这个工作流程规则

  • 直接运动传输：不再需要逐帧分解视频。

  • 卓越的精度：比旧版 LTX 2.3 管道明显更干净、更准确。

  • 硬件友好的优化：围绕官方高度优化的精炼 INT8 ConvRot 架构原生构建。

🧠 发动机：所需型号

为了实现这个奇迹，您需要下载并装备以下官方模型：

  • 📁 LTX 2.5 视频 VAE 转换器 BF16 — 核心视频VAE。

  • 🎵 LTX 2.5 音频 VAE BF16 — 用于完全同步的音频处理器。

  • 🔤 Gemma 4 12B 文本编码器 (Comfy INT8) — 智能提示对齐。

  • 🤖 LTX 2.5 22B 精炼变压器 (Comfy INT8) — 繁重的一代模型。

  • 🔍 LTX 2.5 潜在空间升级器 X2 — 实现清晰、高保真的输出。

  • 🎮 LTX 2.3 22B IC-LoRA 联合控制（参考号 0.5） — 控制液体的秘密武器。

    LTX 2.5 Huggingface 存储库 -https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/tree/main

💬 旋转一下！

试驾并挑战它的极限！我很想听听您对运动保真度的反馈。

👇 秀出你的动作转移！将您的原创视频和新动画角色放入下面的评论库中！ 👇

o.en:
✨ Say goodbye to the tedious chore of splitting videos into pose images! LTX 2.5 Motion Syncis officially here, and it is a massive upgrade over LTX 2.3. This advanced workflow effortlessly transfers precise, lifelike motion fromanysource video directly onto your chosen characters in a single, fluid process! 🔄

⚠️ Heads up, creators: This setup handles realistic and 3D styles like a dream, but it may struggle with flat, 2D anime images.

🛠️ Changelog & Bug Fixes

Fixed in FlyV2.0: Better fidelity & motion adherence. Added a VideoStitch Node for comparison in Output & Original Input. Also added a Metadata Tracker node, for those who want to share their creations on CivitAI.

🎨 Why This Workflow Rules

  • Direct Motion Transfer:No more breaking down videos frame-by-frame.

  • Superior Precision:Noticeably cleaner and more accurate than older LTX 2.3 pipelines.

  • Hardware-Friendly Optimization:Built natively around the official, highly optimized distilled INT8 ConvRot architecture.

🧠 The Engine: Required Models

To make this magic happen, you will need to download and equip the following official models:

  • 📁 LTX 2.5 Video VAE Conv BF16 — The core video VAE.

  • 🎵 LTX 2.5 Audio VAE BF16 — Audio processor for complete sync.

  • 🔤 Gemma 4 12B Text Encoder (Comfy INT8) — Smart prompting alignment.

  • 🤖 LTX 2.5 22B Distilled Transformer (Comfy INT8) — The heavy-lifting generation model.

  • 🔍 LTX 2.5 Latent Spatial Upscaler X2 — For crisp, high-fidelity output.

  • 🎮 LTX 2.3 22B IC-LoRA Union Control (Ref 0.5) — The secret sauce for fluid control.

    LTX 2.5 Huggingface repository -https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5/tree/main

💬 Give it a Spin!

Take it for a test drive and push it to its limits! I would love to hear your feedback on the motion fidelity.

👇 Show off your motion transfers!Drop your original videos and your newly animated characters in the comments gallery below! 👇
